mtr.en: Take MTR South Island Line to Wong Chuk Hang or Island Line to Shau Kei Wan, then transfer to local bus.
mtr.tc: 乘搭港鐵南港島綫至黃竹坑站,或港島綫至筲箕灣站,再轉乘巴士前往。

bus.en: KMB/Citybus routes 6, 6A, 6X, 66, 260 serve the southern beaches; routes 9, 309 serve Shek O and Big Wave Bay.
bus.tc: 九巴/城巴 6、6A、6X、66、260 號線可達港島南各泳灘;9、309 號線可達石澳及大浪灣。

ferry.en: Limited — Stanley can be reached by kaito from Aberdeen on weekends.
ferry.tc: 選擇有限 — 週末可由香港仔乘搭街渡前往赤柱。

car.en: Paid parking available at Repulse Bay, Stanley, Shek O. Arrive before 10am on weekends.
car.tc: 淺水灣、赤柱、石澳設有收費停車場。週末請於上午十時前到達。

materials.en: Plastic, glass, metal, paper, small electronics
materials.tc: 塑膠、玻璃、金屬、紙張、小型電器

mtr.en: MTR Tsuen Wan / Kwun Tong lines connect to most Kowloon waterfronts; transfer to minibus for coastal access.
mtr.tc: 港鐵荃灣綫及觀塘綫連接九龍大部份海濱;轉乘專線小巴前往沿岸位置。

bus.en: KMB routes 2, 6, 11 serve Kowloon waterfront areas.
bus.tc: 九巴 2、6、11 號線途經九龍海濱區。

ferry.en: Star Ferry connects Tsim Sha Tsui to HK Island.
ferry.tc: 天星小輪往返尖沙咀及港島。

car.en: Limited beach parking in Kowloon; prefer public transport.
car.tc: 九龍泳灘附近停車位有限,建議使用公共交通工具。

address.en: Hoi Bun Road Park, Kwun Tong
Tung Chau Street, Sham Shui Po

mtr.en: MTR East Rail / Tuen Ma lines to Tai Po Market, Tai Wai, or Tuen Mun, then transfer to green minibus.
mtr.tc: 乘搭港鐵東鐵綫或屯馬綫前往大埔墟、大圍或屯門站,再轉乘綠色專線小巴。

bus.en: KMB routes 75K, 275R serve Plover Cove; 94 and 96R serve Sai Kung beaches.
bus.tc: 九巴 75K 及 275R 號線往船灣淡水湖;94、96R 號線往西貢各泳灘。

ferry.en: Sai Kung pier kaito serves remote beaches like Sharp Island and Half Moon Bay.
ferry.tc: 西貢碼頭街渡可達橋咀洲及廈門灣等偏遠泳灘。

car.en: Parking at Sai Kung town, Clearwater Bay Country Park, Pak Tam Chung. Fills up early on weekends.
car.tc: 西貢市中心、清水灣郊野公園及北潭涌均設有停車場,週末很快爆滿。

materials.en: Plastic, glass, metal, paper, small electronics
materials.tc: 塑膠、玻璃、金屬、紙張、小型電器

materials.en: Plastic, glass, metal, paper, WEEE, wood
materials.tc: 塑膠、玻璃、金屬、紙張、廢電器電子產品、木材

mtr.en: MTR Tung Chung Line to Tung Chung for Lantau; transfer to bus 3M, 11, 23 for beaches.
mtr.tc: 港鐵東涌綫至東涌站前往大嶼山,再轉乘 3M、11 或 23 號巴士。

bus.en: New Lantao Bus 1, 2, 3M, 11 for Lantau beaches; no bus access on Lamma or Po Toi.
bus.tc: 新大嶼山巴士 1、2、3M、11 號線往大嶼山泳灘;南丫島及蒲台島沒有巴士。

ferry.en: Outlying Islands ferries from Central Pier 4 (Lamma), 5 (Cheung Chau), 6 (Mui Wo/Lantau).
ferry.tc: 中環 4 號碼頭往南丫島、5 號往長洲、6 號往梅窩(大嶼山)的離島渡輪。

car.en: No private cars allowed on Lamma, Cheung Chau, or Peng Chau. Limited parking on Lantau.
car.tc: 南丫島、長洲及坪洲不准私家車進入。大嶼山停車位有限。

item.tc: 獨立回收物收集桶或袋

item.en: Closed-toe shoes (reef shoes for rocky beaches)
item.tc: 包頭鞋(石灘建議溯溪鞋)

item.en: Scale or bag to weigh collected trash
item.tc: 磅或袋以稱量收集垃圾
已儲存緊急聯絡的手機

gazetted.en: Lifeguards on duty during swimming season (Apr–Oct)
gazetted.tc: 泳季(四月至十月)有救生員當值

gazetted.en: Public toilets, showers and shark nets available
gazetted.tc: 設有公廁、淋浴設施及防鯊網

gazetted.en: Follow LCSD rules — no open fires, no glass
gazetted.tc: 遵守康文署規則 — 不准生火、不准攜帶玻璃

nonGazetted.en: No lifeguards — do not swim in strong currents
nonGazetted.tc: 沒有救生員 — 切勿於急流游泳
沒有公廁 — 請預先安排

nonGazetted.en: Carry all trash out; no bins on site
nonGazetted.tc: 場內無垃圾桶,請自行帶走所有垃圾

nonGazetted.en: Tell someone your plan and expected return time
nonGazetted.tc: 請告知他人行程及預計返回時間

nonGazetted.en: Beware of slippery rocks, sharp shells, and jellyfish
nonGazetted.tc: 小心濕滑岩石、尖銳貝殼及水母

nonGazetted.en: Check tide times before arrival — some beaches disappear at high tide
nonGazetted.tc: 出發前查閱潮汐時間 — 部份沙灘漲潮時會被淹沒
